plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.map_domain: The selected Map file is decoded completely and independently through the wowdbdefs-70450-v1 VMap, terrain, and navigation projections. Unknown schemas, encrypted/unavailable bytes, structural errors, and projection disagreement are fatal before package output creation. Availability/partial readers are not used for domain derivation.
source_policy.dependencies: Map and LiquidType are required complete build-specific DB2 inputs. Terrain and VMap products are required for a selected map and its ancestors; missing or unsupported inputs fail closed.
source_policy.real_run_requirement: A real run requires the complete build-70450 Map table, which is currently encrypted under this key-refusing profile, plus the selected terrain and VMap inputs. No keys are accepted; therefore the current real-client run is not runnable.
source_policy.terrain_stage_status: The complete Terrain runner dispatches Map, LiquidMaterial, LiquidObject, and LiquidType through the build-70450 catalogue readers. The synthetic end-to-end extraction exercises these readers and emits MAPS, VMaps, and MMaps; no real client run is claimed.

verification.scope: package integrity, complete 70450 Map domain projections, 70450 terrain/tilelist formats, VMap framing and MMap global/tile framing
verification.source_authentication: Offline package verification checks retained artifact integrity and declared domain relationships; it is not an independent client snapshot or real-runtime acceptance.

legacy_preservation: Revisions 8 and 14 through 20 retain their existing plan and publication behavior; v21 is a separate build-70450 Linux capability.
